faqs.question: What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer haircuts, coloring, highlights, balayage, keratin treatments, blowouts, manicures, pedicures, facials, waxing, and massage therapy.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can book online at luxesalon.com/book, call us at (555) 123-4567, or just ask me and I'll help you get scheduled.

faqs.question: What are your hours?
faqs.answer: Monday–Wednesday 9am–7pm, Thursday–Friday 9am–8pm, Saturday 9am–6pm, and we're closed on Sundays.

faqs.question: How much does a haircut cost?
faqs.answer: Haircuts start at $45 for women and $30 for men. Prices vary based on length and stylist. Color services start at $85.

faqs.question: Do you offer a cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: We ask for 24 hours notice for cancellations. Late cancellations or no-shows may be charged 50% of the service fee.

faqs.question: Do you take walk-ins?
faqs.answer: We do take walk-ins based on availability, but we recommend booking in advance especially on weekends.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: We're at 123 Main St, Cleveland, OH 44101. There's free parking in the rear lot.

faqs.question: Do you offer gift cards?
faqs.answer: Yes! Gift cards are available in any amount — ask at the front desk or purchase online at luxesalon.com/gift.

faqs.question: What hair color brands do you use?
faqs.answer: We use Redken, Wella, and Olaplex for all color services — professional-grade products for long-lasting results.

faqs.question: Do you offer bridal packages?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer full bridal party packages including hair and makeup. Contact us at hello@luxesalon.com to discuss your special day.
